maxTokensHintOpenai: Which key the cap is sent under. max_tokens is the default and most compatible gateways only accept it; OpenAI's reasoning models (o-series / GPT-5) only accept max_completion_tokens and will reject max_tokens with unsupported_parameter.
maxTokensHintAnthropic: Only available for the openai format. Anthropic's field name is fixed as max_tokens.
maxTokensHintResponses: Only available for the openai format. The Responses API's field name is fixed as max_output_tokens.
healthNoKeyHint: No API key entered, so requests can't be made
poolIntro: When enabled, agents without a pinned model automatically switch to the next profile when the current one is unavailable (out of balance / invalid key / rate-limited / service error).
enablePoolDesc: Off by default. When off, only the active profile is used, and a failure is a failure.
fallbackLabel: Fall back even when a pinned model fails
fallbackDesc: Off by default: if an agent or task pins a profile, only that profile is used, and a failure is a failure (it won't quietly switch to another model). When on, a failing pinned profile also falls back to the rotation chain below.
chainTooFew: Only {count} usable profile(s) right now, so rotation won't take effect. At least 2 profiles with an API key entered and included in rotation are needed.
restoreNowTitle: Restore now: clear the trip and retry this profile on the next call
chainNote: The active profile always comes first; the rest are ordered by priority, highest first (set per profile). A profile that fails enters cooldown (60s → 5min → 30min), is skipped during cooldown, and is restored automatically afterwards. Profiles whose context window can't fit the current request are skipped. Agents and tasks with a pinned model are not part of rotation by default.
nameModelRequired: Please enter a name and a model
createdProfile: Created: {name} (click "Set active" on the card to enable it)
savedActive: Saved. The active profile takes effect immediately, no restart needed
newNotActive: A new profile is not activated automatically. Click "Set active" on the card to enable it.
editHint: Click save after editing. Saving the active profile applies to all agents immediately.
loadModelsTitle: Load available models from the API
proxyHelp: Only outbound LLM requests go through this proxy. Supports http/https/socks5, and may include credentials (e.g. socks5://user:pass@host:port; URL-encode special characters in the password). Leave blank for a direct connection.
sessionHeaderHelp: Once a header name is set, every request carries this HTTP header, with the value automatically set to the current session id (e.g. conv-12 for a chat session, exp3-worker-i87 for a worker). Used by gateways that do prompt caching or sticky routing keyed on a session-id header; stable across turns in one session and different between sessions. Leave blank to send nothing.
keySetPlaceholder: Set ({hint}), leave blank to keep unchanged
limitsHelp: Rate limit 0 = unlimited, shared across all agents. Context window is in K (thousand tokens): 0 = default 200K, maximum 1000 (i.e. 1M). Setting it too high prevents compaction from triggering.
priorityHelp: Higher numbers are picked first. The active profile always comes first regardless of this value. Profiles with the same priority take turns leading, which naturally spreads the quota.
excludeHelp: When on, this profile is not used as a failover target (it can still be pinned explicitly by an agent or task). Suited to expensive profiles reserved for one agent that you don't want burned when others fail.
streamHelp: On (default) uses streaming SSE, with live progress and live token counts while running. Off uses true non-streaming (stream:false, the full response returned in one go), which works around poor SSE implementations in some gateways (empty frames / dropped reasoning fields), at the cost of live progress while running.
maxTokensHelp: The maximum number of tokens generated per reply, sent with every request. 0 (default) = the field is not sent and the server default applies. This is separate from the context window above: that is the model's total capacity and is only used locally to compute the compaction threshold. Setting this too low will cut off reasoning models during thinking, so no answer text comes out at all.
thinkingHelp: Controls whether the thinking field is sent. Not sent = the field is omitted (for models like MiniMax that don't support it); off = sends disabled; on = sends enabled. Independent of the strength setting below.
effortHelp: A separate strength level (OpenAI reasoning_effort / Anthropic output_config.effort). Some APIs have no thinking field and only activate thinking through the strength setting, so it can be set on its own without sending the thinking switch.
pageDesc: Format / model / rate-limit profiles shared by all agents. Click a card to edit; the star marks the active profile.
noProfiles: No model profiles yet. Click "New" in the top right to create the first one.
